edits.value_json: Reported Shang oracle-bone examples occur in contexts involving water or flooding, but the source does not identify this particular use as “river” or establish its semantic priority. Separately, one source proposes “river” as the original meaning, while another gives “water” more broadly. The evidence does not establish which meaning was earliest.
